description: karta harness enforcement for Codex: binder immutability, pack write validation, the fail-closed dispatch inspectors (guard_auditor_dispatch.py and guard_gate_dispatch.py on spawn_agent|Agent — a recognized karta-safety-auditor dispatch must carry its binder and pinned-pack checklists, and a recognized gate-reviewer dispatch must carry a real, sized diff, denied on both documented channels before two reviewer contexts spin up), the delivery Stop-gate, the SubagentStop whiff advisory, and the SessionStart status injection (inject_karta_status.py — purely informational: it emits a short fenced karta status summary as session context, always exits 0, and never blocks anything) — the subset of karta's Claude Code hooks that Codex's hook surface can express (docs/how-to/codex.md has the full parity table). Referenced by the 'hooks' entry in .codex-plugin/plugin.json. Codex file edits arrive as apply_patch calls whose tool_input.command is the raw patch body; the guard scripts parse that shape natively. Same contract as everywhere else: hook payload JSON on stdin; exit 0 allows, exit 2 blocks with the reason on stderr (the Stop, SubagentStop, and dispatch-inspector guards also emit their JSON decision on stdout). Each command is a fail-open launcher: if PLUGIN_ROOT does not resolve to the installed plugin on this Codex build, the hook allows rather than wedging the session. That launcher-open posture is not in conflict with the dispatch inspectors' guard-closed posture — the launcher only decides whether a guard runs at all, while the fail-closed rule governs once the guard is running.
